title: Product Sans / Closing Page
slide_intent: End a specimen with a clear signature so the reader retains the connection between the typeface and its parent brand.
strategic_value: A restrained Google signature on a full yellow field can reinforce the identity after the technical specimens.
demonstration: A nearly empty yellow page carries a small white Google wordmark at lower left and copyright and folio labels across the top.
practical_value: Use an uncluttered closing page to separate the brand signature from the preceding detailed reference material.

content_islands.name: Running metadata
content_islands.spec: Align the typeface, copyright, specimen and final folio labels along the top.

content_islands.name: Closing signature
content_islands.spec: Place the small white Google wordmark at lower left on the uninterrupted yellow field.

reference_purposes.Expression: The full yellow field and white wordmark demonstrate a minimal closing brand treatment.
